subject: Exec sponsor availability + security checklist / steering committee prep
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@paragonhealth.com>, David Ruiz <d.ruiz@paragonhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 10 May 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Exec sponsor availability + security checklist / steering committee prep

Hi Sara / David — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get us to a 60‑minute steering committee with your exec sponsor: 

Key takeaways from today
- Top priority: reduce inference cost for clinical search use case while keeping 95th %-ile latency under 250ms for short queries.
- Security/compliance is a gating factor — you need SOC 2 report and evidence of data handling (KV cache controls, retention config).
- Procurement expects a vendor onboarding packet + MSA redline path and an estimated TCO for first 12 months.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Steering committee timing: please share 2–3 windows (60 mins) in the next 14 days when your exec sponsor (economic buyer) can attend. We recommend: May 18–20 between 9–11am PT or May 24–25 afternoon PT.
2) Security: attached is our short security questionnaire and a one‑page runtime security summary. Can your security contact confirm whether SOC2 Type II and MSSP encrypt-at-rest proof suffice? (Attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf)
3) Procurement: David — appreciate if you can share the procurement checklist and vendor onboarding form so we can prefill.
4) Steering committee agenda (proposed): 1) Exec problem statement & success metrics (Paragon), 2) Redwood technical approach and performance/cost profile, 3) Security/compliance checklist, 4) Commercial path & tentative timeline.

Marcus / Priya / Karthik — can you help prepare: Marcus: short customer ROI / unit cost slide; Priya: security/ops slide; Karthik: commercial options and MAP draft. I’ll coordinate calendar and logistics once Sara confirms sponsor availability.

Thanks — looking forward.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555‑0192
Attachment: redwood-security-questionnaire-v1.pdf (PDF), mutual-action-plan-paragon.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Sara Thompson <sara.thompson@paragonhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Ruiz <d.ruiz@paragonhealth.com>, procurement@paragonhealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 May 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec sponsor availability + security checklist / steering committee prep

Thanks Vanessa — great recap. Confirming a few items:

- Exec sponsor (Chief Product Officer, Elise McKenna) is available May 19 10–11am PT or May 25 3–4pm PT. She prefers May 19 if that works for the Redwood team.
- Our security lead (David) will review your questionnaire but needs the SOC2 bridge letter — do you have a template we can use?
- Procurement is copied; their timeline is typically 4–6 weeks after steering committee if terms are agreed. They will want an itemized cost table and an initial SOW.

I'll confirm final availability after checking Elise’s calendar but holding May 19 for now.

Best,
Sara
Sara Thompson
Head of Product Operations, Paragon Health
sara.thompson@paragonhealth.com

Marcus / Priya / Karthik — shorthand for prep:
- Marcus: 5–7 slide ROI / cost comparison (current infra vs Redwood forecast) — highlight 12‑month TCO and breakeven.
- Priya: 2 slides on security & data flows (SOC2 evidence pointers, retention controls, isolation options).

Vanessa

Subject: Internal: pricing note for Paragon steering committee (do not forward)

Vanessa / Marcus — quick internal note before we finalize slides:
- For a two‑phase engagement (pilot then rollout), recommend proposing: 1) 3‑month pilot on hosted with token caps and performance SLAs; 2) 12‑month committed Dedicated pool if pilot meets latency/cost targets.
- Pricing guidance: pilot discount 35% off list for committed volume; Dedicated pricing to be set in MAP with an annual commit.
- Prepare an appendix with fallback/operational SLA language (can be helpful for procurement).

I’ll draft the pricing slide and upload to the shared drive by EOD. Priya — can you confirm which security artifacts we can share pre‑NDA (SOC2 cover letter, runtime diagram, sample retention policy)?

Thanks,
Karthik

Vanessa / Sara — thanks. A couple of procurement items to flag ahead of the steering committee: 

1) We need a redlineable MSA and a vendor security pack (SOC2 Type II report or SOC2 bridge letter) by the steering committee so our legal can do a preliminary review.
2) Please add a clear owner for data residency and a runbook for incident response (high level is fine for now).
3) Attached our vendor onboarding form — fill sections A (vendor contact) and D (service description).

If you can share the SOC2 bridge letter and the MAP updated with a proposed commercial term (commit length + estimated spend), procurement can start a parallel review and likely shorten the 4–6 week window.

Attachment: paragon-vendor-onboarding-form.pdf (PDF)

—
David Ruiz
Vendor Operations, Paragon Health
procurement@paragonhealth.com
